elements.description:
Coordinates made useful – decimal or degrees-minutes-seconds, Copy, links to mapping tools and an embedded map that
loads only when asked.

properties.name: latitude
properties.description: The latitude, −90 to 90 – used when `points` is empty

properties.name: longitude
properties.description: The longitude, −180 to 180 – used when `points` is empty

properties.name: label
properties.description: What the place is, e.g. "North weather mast" – used when `points` is empty

properties.name: zoom
properties.description: The map zoom, 1 (the world) to 19 (a building)

properties.name: points
properties.description: Several places to switch between, instead of latitude / longitude

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The shown point's id when `points` is given; null shows the first. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: notation
properties.description: Decimal (57.041200, −3.612700) or degrees-minutes-seconds. Changed by the user unless a tc-notation-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: precision
properties.description: Decimal places shown in decimal notation

properties.name: providers
properties.default: [ { id: "google", name: "Google Maps", url: "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query={lat},{lng}" }, { id: "apple", name: "Apple Maps", url: "https://maps.apple.com/?ll={lat},{lng}&q={label}&z={zoom}" }, { id: "osm", name: "OpenStreetMap", url: "https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat={lat}&mlon={lng}#map={zoom}/{lat}/{lng}" }, { id: "bing", name: "Bing Maps", url: "https://www.bing.com/maps?cp={lat}~{lng}&lvl={zoom}&sp=point.{lat}_{lng}_{label}" }, ]
properties.description: The mapping tools, replacing the defaults – spread `defaultGeoProviders` to add to them. Only http(s) templates are kept

properties.name: embed
properties.description: The embedded map: "click" waits for Show map (nothing loads until then), "auto" shows it at once, "off" has none

properties.name: embedSrc
properties.description: The embedded map's address as a template with {lat} {lng} {zoom} {label} {bbox}; by default OpenStreetMap's embed

properties.name: embedNote
properties.description: Says where the map loads from under Show map, e.g. "The map loads from openstreetmap.org" – by default the embed's host

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: Another of `points` was picked ({ selected, point }: GeoSelectedChange); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

events.name: tc-notation-change
events.description: Decimal or DMS was picked ({ notation }: GeoNotationChange); cancelable – prevented, `notation` stays as it was

events.name: tc-open
events.description: A mapping link is about to open ({ provider, url, point }: GeoOpen); cancelable – prevented, the link doesn't open

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: The coordinates are about to be copied ({ text, point }: GeoCopy); cancelable – prevented, nothing is copied

functions.name: defaultGeoProviders
functions.description: The mapping tools offered when the page gives none – spread them to add your own

functions.name: defaultGeoEmbedSrc
functions.description: The embedded map when the page gives no `embedSrc`: OpenStreetMap's embed, with {bbox} around the point

functions.name: geoProblem
functions.signature: geoProblem(latitude: unknown, longitude: unknown): string | null
functions.description: Why a point can't be used, in words, or null when it can

functions.name: fillGeoTemplate
functions.signature: fillGeoTemplate(template: string, p: GeoPoint, zoom: number, precision: unknown): void
functions.description: A template filled for a point: {lat} {lng} {zoom} {label} {bbox}, each encoded

props.name: selected
props.description: The shown point's id when `points` is given – controlled when given (null shows the first)

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The point shown on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: notation
props.description: Decimal or DMS – controlled when given

props.name: defaultNotation
props.description: The notation on mount when `notation` isn't controlled

props.name: onOpenMap
props.description: A mapping link is about to open; return false to stop it, e.g. to open your own map

props.name: onCopyCoordinates
props.description: The coordinates are about to be copied; return false to stop it

changelog: `tc-geo-location` – coordinates in decimal or DMS, Copy, Open in Google Maps, Apple Maps, OpenStreetMap, Bing or your own `providers`, and an OpenStreetMap embed that loads nothing until Show map. Generative UI can't set `embed` or `embedSrc`, so a generated map always waits for the click.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
